FreeExerciseDB exercise data and demonstration photographs
Source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db
Pinned revision: f00c92c7dcf1216a928a52c3706c7ce8e2f71ed5
License: Unlicense (public-domain dedication); see free-exercise-db-LICENSE.txt.
Upstream describes its dataset and imagery as public domain and credits
Ollie Jennings and wrkout/exercises.json as the original dataset.
No website icons, frontend code or unrelated branding are imported.

The full 876-record pinned source snapshot was processed. Five records with no
instructions were omitted; equivalent source spellings were combined into 860
catalogue records. Name matches are recorded in tools/exercise-source-matches.json.
Regenerate with tools/import-exercise-db.mjs and the pinned exercises.json.
Existing Gym Tracker names and muscle identities take precedence. Source names
are retained as search aliases only; no saved routine or record is migrated.
Curated variants have original instructions. Unverified variant illustrations
are deliberately omitted rather than borrowing an image of another movement.
Photos are requested only from the pinned source when opening exercise details.
The web service worker keeps at most 80 previously viewed images separately
from the offline catalogue. Uncached/unavailable images show a placeholder.
Android WebView image availability depends on its cache/service-worker support.
